record.body:
## Description

Declare adaptive-artifacts as a Claude plugin dependency, list both plugins in se-workflow's marketplace.json, and rewrite README Claude install to one marketplace add. Leave Cursor as clone/sync + PATH.

## Approach

1. In `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, add `dependencies` for `adaptive-artifacts` (bare name unless release tags already support a semver range).
2. In `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`, keep the se-workflow `./` entry; add an `adaptive-artifacts` entry with github source `andrewy1n/adaptive-artifacts` per Claude marketplace reference.
3. Rewrite README Install Claude section: one `marketplace add andrewy1n/se-workflow`, then install se-workflow (dependency pulls AA). Remove the required second marketplace-add for the happy path; note AA's own marketplace remains for standalone use.
4. README Cursor: keep clone/sync + PATH; do not claim Claude-style dependency auto-install.
5. Run `claude plugin validate .` locally before handing off; fix schema until it passes.
record.subject: claude-shared-marketplace
